description: YINMIK hydroponic meter status() data points (VD-70, #1183) and the climate columns ingestor/hydro_probe.py decodes them to. DPs per the meter's Tuya model: 1 tds_in (ppm), 2 temp_current (degC, scale 1), 7 battery_percentage, 10 ph (scale 2), 11 conductivity_value (mS/cm, scale 3, so raw = uS/cm), 12 orp_value (-1: no ORP probe on this SKU), 107 phmaxlimit (pH alarm limit, scale 2, a setting). Add the dict recorded from the meter at cutover as a new case.

cases.name: ha-calibration-note-2026-04-18
cases.source: jvallery/homeassistant packages/greenhouse/hydroponic_calibration.yaml: the raw values LocalTuya showed on 2026-04-18 (DP 11 2484, DP 10 621, DP 107 1400) against the YINMIK app's pH 6.22, TDS 1240 and EC 2480. HA's template corrections read them as pH 2484/400, TDS 621x2 and EC 1400x1.77.
